Randomly gettin banned with no info won't help me correct any mistakes. Not to mention it doesn't even say if you get banned for being toxic or for griefing. [/quote]

They want the system to be a "black box." However, if you actually received an Overwatch ban (and not just a behavior score drop), it means a group of reviewers manually watched clips of your gameplay. They found you guilty of intentional feeding, destroying items, going AFK, or completely ignoring your role

The system is flawed because it doesn't provide the feedback needed to correct your mistakes — and that is exactly what I intend to change. Without transparency, innocent players just get frustrated, while actual griefers learn absolutely nothing
